Ana Martinez: Hey folks — I opened a small PR that adjusts the console metrics for tracehook latency and adds a lower bucket to the histogram. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/PR/4821
Ben Liu: looking now. which dashboards will pick this up?
Ana Martinez: dashboard 'tracehook/latency' and the new per-model breakdown. I renamed pod_latency -> pod_latency_ms (units are ms).
Cara O'Neill: quick ask — did you convert existing emits or add a new metric? we should avoid duplicate signals.
Ana Martinez: converted the existing emits; added compat alias in telemetry layer for a week. see snippet:
```
# telemetry/metrics.py
HIST_POD_LATENCY = Histogram('pod_latency_ms', buckets=[0,5,10,25,50,100,250,500,1000])
emit('pod_latency_ms', value_ms)
# compat: old name still forwarded for 7 days
emit('pod_latency', value_ms)
```
Devex Bot: FYI @channel new metric name will affect alerts: alerting/tracehook_latency.yaml needs update.
CI Bot: build failed — lint error in telemetry/metrics.py: line 3 trailing whitespace (flake8 E2).
Ben Liu: I'll take the lint fix and push to the branch unless you want to.
Ana Martinez: please do, thx. also added a tiny test for buckets.
Ben Liu: pushed fix + test. CI rerunning.
CI Bot: tests passed ✅ — all checks green.
Cara O'Neill: two tiny nits inline about docstrings and a clearer bucket comment, nothing blocking.
Ana Martinez: addressed both, PTAL.
Ben Liu: left an approval — looks good to me. :thumbsup:
Cara O'Neill: approving as well. one operational note: hold merge until next safe window (today between 17:30-18:30 PT) so SRE can watch canary.
Ana Martinez: understood, scheduling canary for the slot. tagging @SRE Bot for automated canary.
SRE Bot: Canary job created: canary/4821 — scheduled start 2025-06-12T17:45:00Z. Will notify on progress.
Ana Martinez: thanks — merging will be manual after canary looks healthy. I'll ping here when ready to merge.
Ben Liu: thx, appreciate the check.
Devex Bot: Heads-up: doc snippets updated under docs/observability/metrics.md — small note to change dataset ingestion mapping.
Ana Martinez: noted. will follow up with a short changelog PR to docs.
Cara O'Neill: great. thanks for the fast turnaround everyone :rocket:
